step.label: Initiate Campaign and Customer Engagement
step.description: Launch a new product campaign and provision customer accounts to establish market engagement baseline.
step.useCase: Sales operations teams create campaigns and activate customer accounts for new product releases

step.label: Identify and Evaluate Qualified Vendors
step.description: Search and profile approved vendors in the procurement network to support campaign fulfillment requirements.
step.useCase: Procurement specialists review vendor credentials and sourcing capabilities for campaign support

step.label: Certify Materials and Regulatory Compliance
step.description: Validate hazardous substances and regulatory declarations for materials used in production.
step.useCase: EHS teams verify material safety data and regulatory certifications before manufacturing

step.label: Orchestrate Material and Vendor Qualification
step.description: Coordinate multi-criteria qualification of materials and vendors against campaign and compliance requirements.
step.useCase: Supply chain managers run vendor-material compatibility assessments and qualification workflows

step.label: Execute Procurement Purchase Orders
step.description: Create and manage vendor purchase orders for campaign materials and production components.
step.useCase: Buyers issue purchase orders to qualified vendors for campaign-driven production requirements

step.label: Manage Sourcing Campaign and Account Changes
step.description: Update sourcing strategies and account relationships as campaign scope and vendor performance evolve.
step.useCase: Procurement controllers adjust vendor allocations and account terms based on campaign execution

step.label: Request and Track Production Orders
step.description: Translate campaign demand into machine production orders and monitor manufacturing execution.
step.useCase: Production planners schedule machines and track work orders from campaign fulfillment requests

step.label: Register Change and Compliance Incidents
step.description: Log service tickets, change requests, and IT equipment modifications required by production compliance audit trail.
step.useCase: Operations teams document all production changes, equipment updates, and service tickets for regulatory compliance verification
